entries.15세 이상 성인은 1일 3회, 1회 1포(90 mL), 만 11세 이상: Adults aged 15 years and over take 1 sachet (90 mL) per dose 3 times a day; children aged 11 years to under 15 years take 2/3 sachet (about 60 mL) per dose 3 times a day; children aged 7 years to under 11 years take 1/2 sachet (about 45 mL) per dose 3 times a day; children aged 3 years to under 7 years take 1/3 sachet (about 30 mL) per dose 3 times a day; children aged 2 years to under 3 years take 1/4 sachet (about 22.5 mL) per dose 3 times a day, in each case 30 minutes after a meal. If necessary it may be taken at bedtime, and as a rule the interval between doses is 4 hours.

entries.24개월 미만의 소아, 임부 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성 및: Children under 24 months of age, pregnant women, women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women must not take this medicine. entries.류마티양 관절염, 골관절염, 강직성 척추염, 연조직손상, 비관절 류마티스: For rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, soft tissue injury, non-articular rheumatic disease, acute gout and psoriatic arthritis, adults take 1/2 tablet to 1.5 tablets (200 to 600 mg) per dose 3 to 4 times a day, up to a maximum of 3200 mg a day. entries.류마티양 관절염, 골관절염, 강직성 척추염에 성인은 1회 1~2정(275: For rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, and ankylosing spondylitis, adults take 1 to 2 tablets (275 to 550 mg) at a time, twice a day (every 12 hours). For skeletal muscle disorders, pain after surgery, pain after tooth extraction (having a tooth pulled), dysmenorrhea, tendinitis (inflammation of a tendon), and bursitis (inflammation of the lubricating sac), take 2 tablets (550 mg) as the initial dose (the first dose), then take 1 tablet (275 mg) every 6 to 8 hours, and do not let the total daily dose exceed 5 tablets (1,375 mg). If rash and redness, itching, nausea and vomiting, loss of appetite, constipation, edema, difficulty urinating, thirst, dizziness, anxiety, tremor, insomnia, rarely shock symptoms (urticaria, swelling and tightness in the chest immediately after taking it, together with a pale complexion, cold hands and feet, cold sweats and difficulty breathing), mucocutaneous ocular syndrome (Stevens-Johnson syndrome), toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome) (severe symptoms accompanied by high fever, in which rash and redness and blisters like burns appear on the skin all over the body and on the mucous membranes of the mouth or eyes), asthma, liver function disorder (listlessness of the whole body, jaundice), interstitial pneumonia (accompanied by coughing, breathlessness, difficulty breathing and fever), a decrease in urine volume, swelling of the face, hands and feet, heaviness of the eyelids, stiffening of the hands, a rise in blood pressure, headache, myopathy (weakness, cramps in the limbs, paralysis) or the like occurs, stop taking the medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.발진·발적, 가려움, 구역·구토, 식욕부진, 변비, 부종, 어지러움, 드: If rash and redness, itching, nausea and vomiting, loss of appetite, constipation, edema, light-headedness, or, rarely, shock (urticaria, swelling, chest tightness, etc. together with a pale complexion, cold hands and feet, cold sweats, and difficulty breathing), mucocutaneous ocular syndrome (Stevens-Johnson syndrome), toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome), asthma, listlessness of the whole body, jaundice (the skin or the whites of the eyes turning yellow), interstitial pneumonia (accompanied by coughing, shortness of breath, difficulty breathing, and fever), pseudoaldosteronism (decreased urine volume, swelling of the face, hands and feet, heaviness of the eyelids, stiffening of the hands, a rise in blood pressure or headache, etc.), or myopathy (weakness, cramps in the limbs, paralysis, etc.) occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.발진·발적, 가려움, 구역·구토, 식욕부진, 변비, 부종, 어지러움, 불: If rash and redness, itching, nausea and vomiting, loss of appetite, constipation, edema, dizziness, anxiety, tremor, insomnia, rarely urticaria, chest tightness with pallor, cold hands and feet, cold sweat, and difficulty breathing, mucocutaneous ocular syndrome (Stevens-Johnson syndrome), toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome: accompanied by high fever, with severe symptoms such as rash and redness and burn-like blistering), asthma, generalized lassitude, jaundice (the skin or the whites of the eyes turn yellow), or interstitial pneumonia (accompanied by cough, shortness of breath, difficulty breathing, and fever) occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

If the following occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist: rash and redness, itching, nausea and vomiting, loss of appetite, constipation, edema, dizziness, anxiety, tremor, insomnia; rarely shock symptoms (urticaria, swelling (puffiness), and chest tightness right after taking it, together with a pale complexion, cold hands and feet, cold sweat, and difficulty breathing); Stevens-Johnson syndrome (mucocutaneous ocular syndrome); toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome) (severe symptoms accompanied by high fever, with rash and redness and blistering like burns appearing on the skin all over the body and on the mucous membranes of the mouth or eyes); asthma; liver function disorder (general lethargy, jaundice, etc.); interstitial pneumonia (accompanied by cough, shortness of breath, difficulty breathing, fever, etc.); pseudoaldosteronism (decreased urine volume, swelling of the face, hands, and feet, heaviness of the eyelids, stiffening of the hands, raised blood pressure or headache, etc.); or myopathy (weakness, cramping of the limbs, paralysis).
entries.발진·발적, 가려움, 구역·구토, 식욕부진, 변비, 어지러움, 부종, 드: If rash and redness, itching, nausea and vomiting, loss of appetite, constipation, light-headedness, edema, or, rarely, shock symptoms (urticaria, swelling, chest tightness, etc. immediately after taking it, together with a pale complexion, cold hands and feet, cold sweats, and difficulty breathing), mucocutaneous ocular syndrome (Stevens-Johnson syndrome), toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome) (severe symptoms accompanied by high fever, in which rash and redness and blisters like burns appear on the skin of the whole body or on the mucous membranes of the mouth or eyes), asthma, or liver function disorder (listlessness of the whole body, jaundice) occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

If rash and redness, itching, nausea and vomiting, loss of appetite, constipation, dizziness, edema, rarely shock symptoms (urticaria, swelling, or chest tightness immediately after taking it, together with pallor, cold hands and feet, cold sweat, difficulty breathing, etc.), mucocutaneous ocular syndrome (Stevens-Johnson syndrome), toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome) (accompanied by high fever, with severe symptoms such as rash and redness and burn-like blistering appearing on the skin over the whole body, the mouth, or the mucous membranes of the eyes), asthma, or liver function disorder (generalized lassitude, jaundice) occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.발진·충혈되어 붉어짐, 가려움, 심한 복통(배 아픔), 설사, 구토, 복: If rash and congestion causing reddening, itching, severe abdominal pain (stomach ache), diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal discomfort, or convulsions occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

If rash and congested, reddened skin, itching, severe abdominal pain (stomach ache), diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal discomfort, or cramps occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.방귀, 통증, 복통(배아픔), 경련 또는 배에 그득한 느낌과 같은 복부(: If abdominal (belly) discomfort such as flatulence, pain, abdominal pain (stomach ache), cramps, or a feeling of fullness in the abdomen, rarely vomiting, occasionally nausea, borborygmus (the sound of gas in the intestines) or anal itching, diarrhea, an increased number of bowel movements, loss of appetite, itching, elevated LDH, decreased hemoglobin, eosinophilia, or malaise occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.배변 습관에 갑작스러운 변화, 묽은 변, 설사가 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉: If a sudden change in bowel habits, loose stools or diarrhea occurs, stop taking the medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Belching, cramping abdominal discomfort and, occasionally, rumbling in the abdomen, a feeling of abdominal fullness, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea and vomiting may occur.
Constipation and the like may occur.
entries.변비 또는 설사 등이 나타날 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는 약사와: If constipation or diarrhea occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.변비 또는 설사의 증상이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는: If symptoms of constipation or diarrhea appear, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.변비, 설사 등이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는 약사와: If constipation, diarrhea, or similar symptoms appear, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.변비, 설사 등이 나타나는 경우 이 약의 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는: If constipation or diarrhea occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Adults usually take 4 tablets at a time, 3 times a day, before meals or between meals.
entries.보통 성인(만 15세 이상)은 1회 1포(1회 용량)씩, 만 11세 이상: Ordinarily, adults (aged 15 years and older) take 1 sachet (a single dose) at a time; those aged 11 years and older but under 15 years take 2/3 sachet (2/3 of the adult single dose) at a time; and those aged 7 years and older but under 11 years take 1/2 sachet (1/2 of the adult single dose) at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals.
entries.복부팽만감, 구토, 변비, 두드러기, 발진, 가려움 및 혈관 부종 등이: If abdominal distension, vomiting, constipation, urticaria, rash, itching, and angioedema occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.복통, 구토, 설사, 가려움, 두드러기, 홍반성 발진, 얼굴 부기와 같은: Abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, allergic skin adverse reactions such as itching, urticaria, erythematous rash, and facial swelling, and very rarely anaphylaxis may occur.
entries.붉은 반점, 설사, 부전수축(심장박동정지), 중추신경계 기능저하 등이 나: If red spots, diarrhea, incomplete contraction (cardiac arrest), or central nervous system depression occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
If red spots, diarrhea, asystole (cardiac arrest) or depression of central nervous system function appears, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.붉은 반점, 설사, 부전수축(심장박동정지), 중추신경계 기능저하, 구역,: If red spots, diarrhea, asystole (stopping of the heartbeat), decreased central nervous system function, gastrointestinal symptoms such as nausea and vomiting, hypernatremia, congestive heart failure, or edema (swelling) occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.붉은 반점, 설사, 부전수축(심장박동정지), 중추신경계 기능저하가 나타나: If red spots, diarrhea, asystole (cessation of the heartbeat), or reduced central nervous system function occurs, or if there is no improvement in symptoms after about 1 month of taking it, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.붉은 반점, 설사, 부전수축, 중추신경계 기능저하 등이 나타나는 경우 이: If red spots, diarrhea, asystole or depression of central nervous system function appears, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.붉은반점, 설사, 심장박동정지, 중추신경계기능저하, 복부불쾌감, 변비,: If red spots, diarrhea, cardiac arrest, depressed central nervous system function, abdominal discomfort, constipation, loss of appetite, rash or the like occurs, stop taking the medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.비타민 A를 1일 5,000 IU 이상 복용 시 선천성 기형을 일으킬 수: Taking 5,000 IU or more of vitamin A a day may cause congenital malformations. Women within 3 months of pregnancy or women who may be pregnant must not take it.
entries.비타민 C와 같은 환원제는 함께 복용하지 마십시오.비타민 C를 복용하려면: Do not take reducing agents such as vitamin C together with this medicine. If you need to take vitamin C, take it separately with an interval of about 4 hours from this medicine.
entries.사람 태반을 원재료로 사용하여 제조한 것이므로 그 유익성이 위험성을 웃도: Since it is manufactured using human placenta as a raw material, take it only when its benefits outweigh its risks.
entries.생후 6개월 이상의 소아는 1회 0.4~0.6 mL/kg(5 ~ 7 mg: Children aged 6 months and over take a dose of 0.4 to 0.6 mL/kg (5 to 7 mg/kg) at a time at intervals of 4 to 6 hours as needed, not exceeding a maximum of 4 times a day (28 mg/kg). For children weighing 30 kg or less, do not exceed a maximum of 25 mL (300 mg) a day. For the recommended single dose by age group, refer to the approved product information.
entries.생후 6개월 이상의 소아는 1회 0.4~0.6 mL/kg(5~7 mg/k: Children aged 6 months and older take 0.4 to 0.6 mL/kg (5 to 7 mg/kg) per dose as needed at intervals of 4 to 6 hours, not exceeding a maximum of 4 doses a day (28 mg/kg). If the body weight is known, it is more appropriate to take the dose based on body weight, so refer to the approved product information for the recommended doses by age group.

Children 6 months of age and older take 0.4 to 0.6 mL/kg (5 to 7 mg/kg) at a time, as needed at intervals of 4 to 6 hours, not exceeding a maximum of 4 times a day (28 mg/kg). For children weighing 30 kg or less, do not exceed a maximum of 25 mL (300 mg) a day. If the body weight is known, dosing according to body weight is more appropriate, so refer to the approved product information for the recommended dose by age group.

Children aged 6 months and older take 0.4 to 0.6 mL/kg (5 to 7 mg/kg) as 1 dose at intervals of 4 to 6 hours as needed, not exceeding a maximum of 4 doses (28 mg/kg) in 1 day. For children weighing 30 kg or less, do not exceed a maximum of 25 mL (300 mg) in 1 day. For the recommended dose by age group, refer to the approved product information.

Children aged 6 months and over take 0.4 to 0.6 mL/kg (5 to 7 mg/kg) at a time as needed, at intervals of 4 to 6 hours, not exceeding a maximum of 4 times a day (28 mg/kg). For children weighing 30 kg or less, do not exceed a maximum of 25 mL (300 mg) a day. If the body weight is known it is more appropriate to give the dose based on body weight, so refer to the approved labelling for the recommended doses by age group.
entries.생후 6개월 이상의 소아는 1회 0.4~0.6 mL/kg, 4~6시간 간: Children aged 6 months and over take 0.4 to 0.6 mL per kg of body weight per dose, at intervals of 4 to 6 hours when needed, and must not exceed 4 doses a day (28 mg/kg). For children weighing 30 kg or less, do not exceed 25 mL a day. When the body weight is known it is more appropriate to use the amount based on body weight, so refer to the approved product information for details.
entries.설사 시 식사를 계속하는 경우 생음식, 과일, 야채, 매운 음식, 냉동된: If you continue to eat while you have diarrhea, do not eat raw food, fruit, vegetables, spicy food, or frozen food or drinks.
entries.설사, 구역, 구토, 알레르기 반응 등이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지: If diarrhea, nausea, vomiting or an allergic reaction appears, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.성인 1일 1회 1병(20 mL)을 복용합니다.이 약은 경구용으로만 사용: Adults take 1 bottle (20 mL), 1 time a day. Use this medicine for oral administration only; do not use it for injection.
Adults take 1 bottle as 1 dose, 2 times a day.
entries.성인 및 12세 이상은 1회 1~1.5포(1~1.5 g)씩, 1일 3회: Adults and those aged 12 years and older take 1 to 1.5 sachets (1 to 1.5 g) at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes to 1 hour after meals, and if necessary 1 more dose may be taken before bedtime.
entries.성인 및 12세 이상의 소아는 10 mg씩, 1일 1회 복용합니다.2~1: Adults and children aged 12 years and over take 10 mg once a day. Children aged 2 years and over but under 12 years take 10 mg once a day if they weigh 30 kg or more, and 5 mg once a day if they weigh less than 30 kg. Patients who are sensitive to adverse reactions may take it in divided doses in the morning and evening. The dose may be increased or decreased appropriately according to age and symptoms. In patients with renal impairment (kidney disorder), the dose is adjusted according to kidney function. For the dose and frequency in such cases, refer to the approved product information.
entries.성인 및 12세 이상의 소아는 1회 10~20 mL을 1일 4회(식후 및: Adults and children aged 12 years and older take 10 to 20 mL at a time, 4 times a day (after meals and before bedtime).
entries.성인 및 12세 이상의 소아는 1회 1∼1.5 g을 1일 3회 식후 30: Adults and children aged 12 years and older take 1 to 1.5 g at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes to 1 hour after meals. If necessary, 1 more dose may be taken before bedtime. Shake the suspension well before taking it.
entries.성인 및 12세 이상의 어린이는 1회 1~2캡슐씩 1일 2회 복용하십시오: Adults and children aged 12 years and older take 1 to 2 capsules per dose, 2 times a day. Those aged 3 to 12 years take 1 capsule per dose, 3 times a day. Those under 3 years of age take 1 capsule per dose, 2 times a day.
entries.성인 및 15세 이상 청소년은 1회 1포씩, 11세 이상~15세 미만은: Adults and adolescents aged 15 years and older take 1 sachet as 1 dose, those aged 11 years or older and under 15 years take 2/3 of a sachet as 1 dose, those aged 7 years or older and under 11 years take 1/2 of a sachet as 1 dose, and those aged 3 years or older and under 7 years take 1/3 of a sachet as 1 dose, 3 to 6 times a day without water. The interval between doses should be 2 hours or more.
entries.성인 및 15세 이상은 1회 1매, 1일 3회 입 안에서 녹여 복용합니다: People aged 15 years and over and adults take 1 film per dose, 3 times a day, letting it dissolve in the mouth. The interval between doses must be 4 hours or more. Take this medicine (film) in the following order. Open the aluminum sheet, peel it away slowly from the mouth and take out only the medicine (film). (Do not swallow the whole aluminum sheet. It may lead to an unexpected accident such as the sheet lodging in the mucous membrane of the esophagus.) Place this medicine (film) on the tongue and take it while it dissolves in the saliva. This medicine (film) is a film that dissolves easily in water, so do not handle it with wet hands. This medicine (film) dissolves in the mouth immediately, but if it sticks to the throat, drink water and swallow it. Also, if there is little saliva and it is difficult to take, put water in the mouth and take it while it dissolves.
entries.성인 및 15세 이상은 1회 35~52.5 mg씩, 1일 2~3회 복용합: Adults and those 15 years and older take 35 to 52.5 mg at a time, 2 to 3 times a day. Do not exceed a maximum of 105 mg a day. Those aged 6 to 14 years take 35 mg at a time, and those aged 2 to 5 years take 17.5 mg at a time, twice a day.
entries.성인 및 6세 이상의 소아는 1일 1회 1정(10 mg)을 취침 전에 복: Adults and children aged 6 years and older take 1 tablet (10 mg) once a day before bedtime; patients who are sensitive to adverse reactions take 1/2 tablet (5 mg) each as divided doses in the morning and evening. Adjust the dose appropriately according to age and symptoms. In patients with renal impairment the dosing interval must be adjusted according to the patient's renal function, and in pediatric patients with renal impairment the dose must be adjusted individually taking into account the patient's renal clearance and body weight, so refer to the approved labeling for details.
entries.성인 및 7세 이상의 어린이는 1회 1정(200 mg)씩 1일 3회 복용: Adults and children aged 7 years and over take 1 tablet (200 mg) at a time, 3 times a day.
entries.성인 및 8세 이상의 소아는 포장단위 1포(20 ml) 기준으로 1일 2: Adults and children aged 8 years and over take 20 to 40 mL (1 to 2 sachets) a day, based on a package unit of 1 sachet (20 mL). Depending on the symptoms, children in particular may take 20 mL (1 sachet) every two days. Dissolve 20 mL (1 sachet) of this medicine in water to make 50 mL and take it. It is recommended to take it in the morning. Children from 6 months to 7 years of age, based on a package unit of 1 sachet (8 mL), take 8 mL (1 sachet) a day at 6 months to 1 year of age, 8 to 16 mL (1 to 2 sachets) a day at 1 to 4 years of age, and 16 to 32 mL (2 to 4 sachets) a day at 4 to 7 years of age. When 1 sachet (8 mL) a day is taken, take it in the morning, and when more than 1 sachet (8 mL) a day is taken, divide it between morning and evening. Dissolve 8 mL (1 sachet) of this medicine in water to make 50 mL and take it.

Adults and children aged 8 years and older take 20 to 40 ml (1 to 2 packets) a day, based on a package unit of 1 packet (20 ml). Depending on symptoms, children in particular may take 20 ml (1 packet) every other day. Dissolve 20 ml (1 packet) of this medicine in water to make 50 ml and then take it. It is recommended to take it in the morning. For children from 6 months to 7 years of age, based on a package unit of 1 packet (8 ml), children 6 months to 1 year of age take 8 ml (1 packet) a day, children 1 to 4 years of age take 8 to 16 ml (1 to 2 packets) a day, and children 4 to 7 years of age take 16 to 32 ml (2 to 4 packets) a day. If 1 packet (8 ml) a day is taken, take it in the morning; if more than 1 packet (8 ml) a day is taken, divide the dose between morning and evening. Dissolve 8 ml (1 packet) of this medicine in water to make 50 ml and then take it.
entries.성인 및 만 12세 이상 소아는 1일 3-4회(사용간격은 최소 2시간 이: Adults and children aged 12 years and older take 1 tablet per dose, 3-4 times a day (with an interval of at least 2 hours between doses), letting it dissolve slowly in the mouth without chewing or swallowing it.
entries.성인(15세이상)은 1회 1정을 1일 3회 식전(식간(식사때와 식사때 사: Adults (aged 15 years and older) take 1 tablet at a time, 3 times a day, before meals (between meals (between one meal and the next) or after meals).However, take the smallest amount for the first dose and gradually increase (raise the amount) or decrease (reduce) it while observing the form and condition of the stools.
entries.성인(만 15세 이상)은 1회 1포씩, 만 11세 이상~만 15세 미만은: Adults (15 years and older) take 1 sachet at a time, those 11 years and older but under 15 years take 2/3 sachet at a time, those 7 years and older but under 11 years take 1/2 sachet at a time, those 3 years and older but under 7 years take 1/3 sachet at a time, and those 1 year and older but under 3 years take 1/4 sachet at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals.
entries.성인, 12세 이상 어린이 및 청소년은 이 약 1개를 입안에서 서서히 녹: Adults and children and adolescents aged 12 years and over take 1 piece of this medicine, letting it dissolve slowly in the mouth. Move it around in the mouth while taking it in order to avoid local irritation. If necessary, take up to a maximum of 5 a day at intervals of 3 to 6 hours, and use it for a maximum of 3 days.
entries.성인에서 복통 및 복부팽만, 설사, 구역, 흔하지 않게 구토, 긴급한 배: In adults, if abdominal pain and abdominal distension, diarrhea or nausea appears, if vomiting, urgent defecation or fecal incontinence uncommonly appears, if electrolyte disturbance (hyponatremia, hypokalemia, etc.), dehydration or erythema appears at an unknown frequency, or if a hypersensitivity reaction (itching, rash, facial edema, angioedema, urticaria, anaphylactic shock, etc.) very rarely appears, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. In children, if abdominal pain, diarrhea or perianal pain caused by diarrhea appears, if vomiting, abdominal distension or nausea uncommonly appears, or if a hypersensitivity reaction (hypersensitivity, angioedema, urticaria, rash, itching, etc.) appears at an unknown frequency, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

In adults, if abdominal pain and bloating, diarrhea, or nausea occurs, uncommonly vomiting or urgent bowel movements, with unknown frequency fecal incontinence, electrolyte disturbances (hyponatremia, hypokalemia, etc.), dehydration, or erythema, or very rarely hypersensitivity reactions (itching, rash, facial swelling, angioedema, hives, anaphylaxis, shock, etc.), stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. In children, if abdominal pain, diarrhea and pain around the anus caused by diarrhea occurs, uncommonly vomiting, abdominal bloating, or nausea, or very rarely hypersensitivity reactions (hypersensitivity, angioedema, hives, rash, itching, etc.), stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.성인은 1일 10~30 mL를 식간에 분할 복용합니다.이 약 10 mL를: Adults take 10 to 30 mL a day in divided doses between meals. Take 10 mL of this medicine diluted (thinned) in about half a cup of water.
Adults take 10 to 30 mL a day, divided into several doses between meals. Dilute 10 mL of this medicine in about half a cup of water before taking it.
entries.성인은 1일 1회 철로서 100㎎, 12세 이상 어린이～19세 미만은 1: Adults take 100 mg as iron once a day; children aged 12 years and older to under 19 years take 50 mg as iron at a time, twice a day; children aged 1 year and older to under 12 years take 50 mg as iron at a time, 1 to 2 times a day; and children aged 1 year and under take 15–50 mg as iron once a day, before, during, or after a meal.

Before taking this medicine, patients with liver disorder or a history of it, patients with kidney disorder or a history of it, people who have had peptic ulcer, patients with blood abnormalities or a history of them, a bleeding tendency, cardiac dysfunction, or a history of hypersensitivity, patients with bronchial asthma, elderly people (the aged), pregnant or breastfeeding women, people who are under treatment by a doctor or dentist, and patients with low glutathione reserves should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Without the direction of a doctor or pharmacist, do not take it for pain for more than 10 days (adults) or more than 5 days (children), and do not take it for fever for more than 3 days.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 소화성궤양, 심한 혈액이상, 심한 간장애, 심한 신장애: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, peptic ulcer, severe blood abnormalities, severe liver disorder, severe kidney disorder, severe cardiac insufficiency, severe high blood pressure, or bronchial asthma, or those with a history of these, people who have experienced asthma, urticaria, or an allergic reaction to aspirin or another non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesic (including COX-2 inhibitors), patients being treated for pain occurring before or after coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery, and women who are pregnant or may be pregnant or are breastfeeding must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have a history of peptic ulcer, blood abnormalities or a history of them, a bleeding tendency (platelet dysfunction may occur), liver disorder or a history of it, kidney disorder or a history of it, cardiac insufficiency, high blood pressure, a history of hypersensitivity, systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) or mixed connective tissue disease (MCTD), ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, are elderly or a child, or have stomach cancer. Considering the importance of the medication, either stop breastfeeding or stop the medication. Dizziness or fatigue may occur after taking this medicine, so take care when driving or operating machinery. When taking it long term for an acute condition, keep it to within 5 days as a rule.

Before taking this medicine, people who have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to caramel, people with urinary retention (urine collecting) problems, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant, breastfeeding women, and people who take it continuously for 15 days or longer should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.

entries.이 약에 과민증, 염증성 대장 질환(궤양성 대장염, 크론병), 위장관 폐: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, inflammatory bowel disease (ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease), gastrointestinal obstruction, abdominal pain of unknown cause, or hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, infants, young children, and children, elderly people, and patients with diabetes, fructose intolerance, fluid and electrolyte imbalance, acute gastritis, or chronic constipation should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 염증성 장질환 환자(궤양성 대장염, 크론병 등), 독성: People who are hypersensitive to this medicine and patients with inflammatory bowel disease (ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, etc.), toxic megacolon, intestinal perforation, intestinal obstruction, intestinal stricture, or abdominal pain of unknown cause must not take this medicine. Do not take this medicine for a long period without a doctor's judgment. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding, if you have acute constipation not caused by a change in lifestyle habits (such as acute constipation accompanied by pain, fever, or abdominal distension), if you have irritable bowel syndrome, or if you have a hypersensitivity reaction to macrogol (polyethylene glycol). Do not give this medicine to children for more than 3 months.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 염증성 장질환(궤양성 대장염, 크론병 등), 독성거대결: This medicine must not be taken by patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, by patients with inflammatory bowel disease (ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, etc.) or toxic megacolon, by patients with intestinal perforation or at risk of intestinal perforation, by patients who have or are suspected of having intestinal obstruction, by patients with intestinal stricture, or by patients with abdominal pain of unknown cause. In children, do not give this medicine for 3 months or more, and do not give this medicine for a long period without the judgment of a doctor.

entries.천식 등 과민반응이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는 약사와: If a hypersensitivity reaction such as asthma occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.출혈성뇌졸중, 구역·구토, 목마름(지속적이거나 심한), 변비, 식욕부진,: If hemorrhagic stroke, nausea and vomiting, thirst (persistent or severe), constipation, loss of appetite, rash and redness, itching, difficulty urinating (passing urine), headache, facial flushing, abnormal sensitivity to light, or rarely shock (anaphylaxis) occur, in which urticaria, swelling, and chest tightness appear immediately after taking the medicine together with pallor, cold hands and feet, cold sweats, and difficulty breathing, or if symptoms do not improve after taking 5 to 6 doses, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.충수염, 장출혈, 궤양성 결장염 등의 급성 복부질환 환자, 장폐색 환자,: Patients with acute abdominal disease such as appendicitis, intestinal bleeding or ulcerative colitis, patients with intestinal obstruction, and patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, children aged 10 years or under, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant, patients with severe abdominal pain, nausea or vomiting, people with an allergic constitution, people on a sodium-restricted diet, people who have experienced rectal bleeding or bowel failure, and patients who are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 4 or tartrazine or have experienced such hypersensitivity should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If constipation does not improve after taking it for about 1 week, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take it continuously for more than 1 week. Do not chew the tablets when taking them. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.
entries.칼륨함유제제, 감초함유제제, 글리시리진산 혹은 그 염류 함유제제, 루프계: People who are taking potassium-containing preparations, licorice-containing preparations, preparations containing glycyrrhizic acid or its salts, loop diuretics (furosemide, ethacrynic acid), or thiazide diuretics (trichlormethiazide) should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Do not take it together with theophylline, ritonavir, or excessive amounts of alcohol.
entries.테트라사이클린, 디곡신, 플루오로퀴놀론, 철염, 케토코나졸, 신경이완제,: When taking it together with tetracycline, digoxin, fluoroquinolones, iron salts, ketoconazole, neuroleptics, thyroxine, penicillamine, beta blockers (atenolol, metoprolol, propranolol), glucocorticoids, chloroquine, estramustine, diphosphonates, and the like, leave an interval of at least 2 hours between doses.
entries.테트라사이클린계 항생물질과 함께 복용하지 마십시오.비스테로이드소염진통제(: Do not take together with tetracycline antibiotics. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you take it together with non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics (NSAIDs), ulcer medicines, digitalis preparations, chlorpromazine, lansoprazole, prednisolone, penicillin, quinolones, iron (Fe) salt preparations, or salicylates.
Do not use it together with a tetracycline antibiotic.
entries.테트라사이클린계 항생물질을 함께 복용하지 마십시오.이 약의 흡착작용 또는: Do not take tetracycline antibiotics together with this medicine. Because of the adsorptive action of this medicine or the rise in pH in the digestive tract and body fluids, it may affect the absorption and excretion of medicines taken together with it.
Do not take this medicine together with tetracycline antibiotics.
entries.투석요법을 받고 있는 환자, 만 3개월 미만의 젖먹이, 갈락토오스 불내성: Patients undergoing dialysis, nursing infants under 3 months of age, and patients with genetic problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with renal impairment, people with an allergic constitution, and people on a sodium-restricted diet should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 2 weeks, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.투석요법을 받고 있는 환자, 만 7세 이하의 어린이, 갈락토오스 불내성,: Patients receiving dialysis therapy, children aged 7 years or younger, and patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, people with kidney disorder, people with an allergic constitution, and people on a sodium-restricted diet should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When administering it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 2 weeks, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.투석요법을 받고 있는 환자는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을 복용하기: Patients receiving dialysis must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with phosphate deficiency or kidney disorder and those who have had kidney disease should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take it continuously for a long period.
entries.투석요법을 받는 환자, 만 3개월 미만의 젖먹이, 갈락토오스 불내성, L: Patients receiving dialysis, nursing infants under 3 months of age, and patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption should not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, nursing infants aged 3 months to under 1 year, patients with renal impairment, people with an allergic constitution, and people on a sodium-restricted diet should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If there is no improvement in symptoms after about 2 weeks of use, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly.
entries.티아지드계 이뇨제, 코르티코스테로이드, 카베녹솔론, 암포테리신B, 배당체: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when using it together with thiazide diuretics, corticosteroids, carbenoxolone, amphotericin B, glycosides, or alpha-glucosidase inhibitors (acarbose, voglibose).
entries.피부염, 땀ㆍ호흡 시 악취, 탈모, 조급증, 구토, 알레르기 등이 나타나: If dermatitis, a foul odor of sweat and breath, hair loss, restlessness, vomiting, or allergy occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.항암요법으로 고용량 메토트렉세이트를 투여중인 환자, 다른 비스테로이드성: Patients receiving high-dose methotrexate as cancer chemotherapy should not take this medicine, and do not take this medicine together with other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics. Before taking this medicine, people taking low-dose aspirin or ACE inhibitors and patients taking lithium, furosemide and thiazide diuretics, low-dose methotrexate, coumarin anticoagulants (such as warfarin), or selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Do not take it together with an antipsychotic or a sleeping pill.
entries.항히스타민제, 항세로토닌, 근이완제(파파베린)와 함께 사용 시 의사 또는: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when using it together with antihistamines, antiserotonin agents, or muscle relaxants (papaverine).
entries.현기증, 위장장애, 상복부 통증, 메스꺼움, 설사, 홍반, 발진, 반구진: If dizziness, gastrointestinal disorders, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, erythema, rash, maculopapular rash, hives, eczema, itching, swelling, or fluid retention in patients with heart failure occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.혈압강하제, 알코올, 중추신경억제제(수면제, 진정제, 안정제), MAO: Do not take this medicine together with antihypertensives, alcohol, central nervous system depressants (sleeping pills, sedatives, tranquilizers), MAO inhibitors, sympathomimetics, tricyclic antidepressants, guanethidine, bretylium, bethanidine, debrisoquine, methyldopa, sympathomimetic drugs (decongestants, appetite suppressants, amphetamine-type stimulants) or adrenergic blocking agents (inhibitors). Administer this medicine at least 15 days after administration of an MAO inhibitor.
entries.혈액학적 이상 반응 등이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는: If hematological adverse reactions occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.혈액학적 이상반응이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는 약사와: If hematological adverse reactions occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.흥분(특히 어린이), 현저한 졸음, 불안, 어지러움 또는 불면증, 인후(: If excitement (especially in children), marked drowsiness, anxiety, dizziness or insomnia occur, if a sore throat continues for 2 days or more or is accompanied by headache, fever, rash, nausea or vomiting, if severe skin adverse reactions such as acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis (AGEP), fever, erythema and numerous small pustules occur, or if ischemic colitis (sudden abdominal pain, rectal bleeding, etc.) occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. If symptoms of posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome or reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome (sudden severe headache, thunderclap headache, nausea, vomiting, confusion, seizures, visual disturbances, etc.) occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
